name: uninstall
description: Take back exactly what the install graph put on this machine, in the reverse of the order install built it: the cluster goes before the hosts entries it answered on and the checkout it was reconciled from, and each tool outlives the artifact it is needed to remove.

steps.description: Delete the installer's marked block from the system hosts file, leaving every other line alone.
Uninstall the local mkcert CA from the system trust stores, delete its key material, and remove the front-door certificate and private key it issued.
steps.sharedReason: The mkcert root CA is per machine, not per project -- it may be signing certificates for your other local stacks. Removing it makes those untrusted too. The front-door certificate and private key MemQL issued go with it; they are MemQL's own and are only removed when MemQL issued them.

steps.description: Remove the installed k3d binary -- after the cluster it manages is gone.
steps.sharedReason: k3d creates and manages local Kubernetes clusters generally, not only MemQL's.

steps.description: Remove the installed kubectl binary -- after the cluster it talks to is gone.
steps.sharedReason: kubectl talks to any Kubernetes cluster, not only MemQL's.

steps.description: Remove the installed mkcert binary -- after the CA it is needed to uninstall is gone.
steps.sharedReason: mkcert issues locally-trusted certificates for any project on this machine.
